title: questlog sessions.json
description: OPTIONAL per-roadmap record of the AI work sessions that have written to this road. Lives at <projectRoot>/.questlog/sessions.json alongside roadmap.json. Absent file = empty panel, no validator output at all (absence is normal). Present file is validated strictly. schemaVersion stays 1 (back-compatible: old dirs load fine). Frozen against Build Plan Section 1.2.

id.description: REQUIRED free-form non-empty session id (UUIDs typical). NOT the lowercase id regex used by roadmap entities. Unique within this file, max 200 chars, no control characters.

firstSeenAt.description: REQUIRED. When this session was first seen writing to this road.

lastSeenAt.description: REQUIRED. When this session most recently wrote to this road.

label.description: REQUIRED string, may be empty. Human-readable session label (typically from session_hello).

eventCount.description: REQUIRED integer >= 0. Number of history.jsonl events stamped with this sessionId.

lastPulse.description: OPTIONAL. Last heartbeat from the PostToolUse pulse hook (throttled to once/60s). A pulse is NOT an event: it never bumps eventCount. Absent/null = no pulse recorded. Old files without this key stay valid.

focus.description: OPTIONAL, <=120 chars. What the session last touched (tool name + optional file basename), set alongside lastPulse. Old files without this key stay valid.

dirty.description: OPTIONAL (C5, dec-currency-architecture). true = this session used a MUTATING tool (edit/write/mutating command/another server's MCP tool) and has not written anything to the road since. Set by the PostToolUse hook; cleared by ANY questlog write (mcp stampHistory, hook upsertSession, board write). The Stop hook nudges when it is still true — it NEVER blocks. HONESTY LIMIT: intent is unreadable, so Bash counts as mutating even when it only read; a false nudge is possible and the copy says so. Absent or false = clean. Read-only sessions never set it. Old files without this key stay valid.

dirtyAt.description: OPTIONAL. When the dirty bit was FIRST set (an already-dirty row keeps its original stamp — the nudge is about 'since when'). Present only alongside dirty:true; removed when the bit is cleared. Old files without this key stay valid.

parentSessionId.description: OPTIONAL. The session this one was BRANCHED from (forked with --resume <parent> --fork-session). Present only on branch sessions; the roster groups children under their parent with a branch glyph. Absent = a session with no lineage. Old files without this key stay valid.
